text_blocks.snippet: Skeletal muscle cancer, also known as rhabdomyosarcoma, is a type of soft tissue sarcoma that originates in cells that develop into skeletal muscles. It is most common in children and adolescents, though it can occur in adults, and often appears in the head and neck, arms, legs, and trunk of the body.
